name: ai-elements
title: AI Elements (shadcn chat primitives)
responsibility: The official shadcn/ui registry for AI-native UI: conversation scroller, message bubbles + actions/branches, reasoning (thinking), prompt-input composer, sources/citations, tasks/tools, plan/queue/checkpoint, code-block. ALL chat/AI-related presets must compose on these primitives — never hand-roll bubbles, stick-to-bottom, streaming indicators, or composer plumbing.

packages.ai: type-only in vendored code (UIMessage, FileUIPart) — devDep at root, externalized
packages.shiki: code-block only — devDep at root, externalized

items.reasoning: thinking/open reasoning with shimmer while streaming
items.prompt-input: composer: attachments, suggestions, context providers, model/mode controls (needs command/dropdown-menu/hover-card/input-group/select)
items.chain-of-thought: step-by-step reasoning trace with badge status
items.artifact: side artifact viewer w/ fullscreen + actions
items.web-preview: inline browser mock w/ address bar

reachFor: Any chat transcript, assistant answer, composer, reasoning/thinking surface, citation strip, streaming status
Message action bars (copy/reload/branch/thumbs) — use MessageActions + MessageAction, do not hand-roll icon-button bars
Auto-scrolling conversation tails — use Conversation, do not hand-roll scroll anchoring
avoid: Non-chat app chrome (desks, rosters, ops boards) — shadcn base kit + tokens is enough
Radix overlays already vendored in preset (tooltip/hover-card) — items reuse them, don't double-vendor
Hardcoding assistant styling — tokens from the preset carry the brand
pitfalls: Tailwind v3 presets: AI Elements targets v4; vendored items may use size-*/ring-*/aria-* v4-era classes (all compile in v3.4). Group-variant classes like group-[.is-user] work in v3.4.
message/reasoning import streamdown (runtime); prompt-input/tool/confirmation/context import `ai` (types only where marked). Keep `ai`/`shiki` out of bundled output via vite externals.
plan/reasoning import ./shimmer — always vendor shimmer alongside.
conversation depends on use-stick-to-bottom — the scroller behavior is theirs, keep it.
